text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the nature of your abdominal pain and tell me exactly where it is located?

text: 47-year-old female. The patient describes a 3-week history of generalized fatigue, mild fever, abdominal pain, and nausea. She recalls attending the state fair over a month ago where she tried various regional foods. speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes, and have you experienced any itching? I am concerned about possible hepatitis given your recent food exposure and dark urine.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and mild fever. I also have Abdominal pain, Nausea, Dark urine.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, and has your stool become pale or clay-colored? I would also like to check for tenderness in your right upper quadrant.
